resources.string: What are you going to drink?
%1$.1f standard drinks consumed this past week.

According to the National Institute of Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism, heavy drinking for men is 5 or more standard drinks a day or 15 or more standard drinks a week. For women, heavy drinking is 4 or more standard drinks in a day or 8 or more in a week. But what is standard drink? \n\nA standard drink is 1.5 ounces of 80 proof alcohol or 12 ounces of beer at 5% alcohol by volume or 12 ounces of wine at 5% alcohol by volume. In the real world, drinks aren\'t so easy to measure. So this app computes your drink into standard drinks and log the results of that so you can keep track.
Looking for more data? Sorry we only hold drink data for the week!
Either there is no data or the data was older than a week and it got purged. Drinkwise only saves data for a week.
